soundness_flags.label: Theorem 2
soundness_flags.one_line: “Every binary face inherits the corresponding geometry-rescaled statement” leaves the affine observation/action rescaling and transformed risk unspecified.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 3
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed upper bound invokes “its plug-in risk,” but no plug-in face rule is defined.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 4
soundness_flags.one_line: The stated three-cell geometry fixes p,q,b,Omega but not the tangent basis B; Q, the diagonal comparator class, and the six normal rays therefore remain coordinate-dependent and unpinned.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 1
soundness_flags.one_line: Normal-ray limits and nested-face agreement are not given a convergence topology or a representative-invariant criterion on the Lebesgue-a.e. quotient rule space.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 3
soundness_flags.one_line: The numerical instance inherits the unchosen B problem, so EdgeCert and the asserted common-scaling gap do not designate one reproducible Gaussian experiment.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 2
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Finite-code recovery is conditional on an affirmative existence-and-essential-uniqueness answer for the global minimax map.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Polynomial value-and-map certification conditional on a uniquely bound global minimax representative.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 4
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Causal attainment is conditional on both global-selector binding and certified Gaussian computation.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Expanding-local exact-capacity attainment conditional on the resolved Gaussian game and its finite certificate.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 5
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Joint policy-welfare inference is conditional on the selector, certificate, and causal-attainment obligations.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Honest joint inference conditional on the preceding Gaussian and causal construction results.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Proposition 3.2 selects the unique H-minimizer among posterior-optimal couplings, and Theorem 3.3 states average optimality under Assumptions 3.1–3.6.
The paper develops Gaussian limit-experiment treatment-rule theory and a local asymptotic minimax result for finite local parameter sets under its unconstrained binary-action formulation.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Journal abstract; theorem text was inaccessible at the publisher. Corroborating preprint: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2205.08586, pp. 17–18, Theorem 4.2 discussion.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published abstract identifies mean-square regret and closed-form Bayes/minimax treatment fractions; the accessible preprint discussion identifies a symmetric two-point least-favorable prior and logistic posterior-probability rule.
The article develops semiparametrically motivated observational policy learning with doubly robust causal-effect estimation and asymptotic utilitarian-regret guarantees.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Fix one explicit oriented tangent basis B for the three-cell experiment, then recompute Q, the six normals, tangents, and comparator class in that coordinate system.
Define face convergence in a representative-invariant metric, specify the residual parameter embedding along each normal flag, and define the face plug-in rule whose risk is bounded.

After the repaired numerical geometry, add a worked certified small-instance output or a second named published comparator against which a strict frontier is stated; this would make the global-map contribution more credible above field tier.

recommended_next_step: Revise the undefined face-limit, plug-in, rescaling, and three-cell coordinate specifications, then rerun novelty review on the fixed core.
